$comment: Provider Negotiator evaluation trace - shows the decision-making process on the Provider side, corresponding to IPolicyNegotiator.handleOffer() in @twin.org/rights-management-models. The key difference from UC6's negotiator-evaluation.json is finalDecision.directAgreement: true, which the PNP service (policyNegotiationPointService.ts) checks immediately after handleOffer() resolves - see requestFromConsumer(). When true (and interventionRequired is false), the PNP skips scheduling sendOfferToConsumer and instead calls sendAgreementToConsumer directly, per the DSP 2025-1 REQUESTED -> AGREED transition.
